note: The deposit's camera-level `Dog_occu` covariate is an occupancy estimate the authors derived from the same detections; it is not shipped (model output, standard E2). Dog detections are the taxon `DOG`.

Baird's tapir is IUCN Endangered, so the deposited camera coordinates are generalised to 0.1-degree cell centres with `unit_coordinateUncertaintyInMeters` set to the cell half-diagonal (standard E7). The source holds the exact locations.

Capture histories from a MARK `.inp`. Four individuals were removed from the population at their last capture (loss on capture): their rows end at that session with `obs_removed = 1`, and no row follows (standard E4.4).

Trap usage is not deposited: every one of the 60 Elliott traps per grid is taken as set on all five nights of every session (`surveyEvidence = inferred`). Each individual carries rows for all six sessions at its grid, including sessions without a capture.
Same inferred trap usage and full-rectangle layout as the swamp rat table. Two deposited rows are prose notes ('no LTM during third session'), not captures, and are dropped.
Transect labels are specific to each survey day and the deposit does not match them across days, so each transect walk is its own unit and there is no `period`. Temperature and humidity are per day.

5 of 1,491 detections are not shipped (3 beyond 100 m, 1 in an ambiguous 20-50 m band, 1 without a band). Heard-only detections are included with their recorded band. Transect coordinates are coarsened to 0.1 degree because the community includes IUCN Vulnerable taxa; the source gives them with a 500 m uncertainty.

The deposit has no readme; column meanings come from the paper, and the emergent-vegetation, livestock and water-type classes are defined only in its supplementary table. The companion qPCR-level table describes the same 168 sites but the deposit gives no key to join the two files. Which field season (2015 or 2016) a site belongs to is not deposited.

The site-level visual/dipnet survey (the certain-detection method of the authors' false-positive model, occuFP code 2) is carried as the covariate `unit_visual_dipnet_detected`, not as rows, because it sits at a coarser level than the qPCR replicates.

Counts are flocks, not birds (the authors' model unit); per-flock bird counts by sex are in the deposit's composition file and not shipped. 24 of 52 plots were surveyed without the double-observer protocol and carry totals only; plot S36 has one unattributed flock; both are omitted. The paper reports the protocol on 29 plots, the deposit attributes 28.
Site covariates in the unmarked `widewt` file are standardised, as the package ships them; the raw elevation, forest and length values are not in the package.
Site and observation covariates in `unmarked::mallard` are standardised, as the package ships them.

`AHMbook::MHB2014` gives quadrat coordinates (`unit_x`, `unit_y`) without a stated CRS; `crs` is recorded as unspecified. The deposited counts are shipped; the package's detection/non-detection view is a recode of them.
